refusal_unverified_bundle: This bundle did not verify. Its records, rows and payloads are not shown; the verification page below lists which checks failed.

unable.reason: This viewer cannot compute the SHA-256 digests the checks need, so nothing was checked and no records are shown. This is not a failed check: the file may well be valid.
unable.no_command: To check this file, open it from a secure (https) page, or check it with a verifier outside this viewer.

check_lines.record-digests: Whether each record still matches the fingerprint it was sealed with.
check_lines.record-rules: Whether each record has the fields it needs, and whether its effects, its verdict, its link to the record before it and its assurance claims are consistent.
check_lines.closure: Whether every record the main record cites, to the stated depth, is in this file or listed as missing.
check_lines.range: Whether any record is missing from the part of the log this file covers.
check_lines.membership: Whether each record that names a place in the log is at that place.
check_lines.checkpoint-signature: Whether the signature on the log's checkpoint is valid.
check_lines.disclosures: Whether each value shown still matches the fingerprint its record was sealed with.
check_lines.countersignatures: Whether each countersignature is a valid signature over this file, by the key it names.
check_lines.composed: Whether each file this one combines, and the fingerprint over the combination, still match.
check_lines.cited-signers: Whether the producer's signature is valid on the records this page names as signers, each marked beside it. Not the signature on every record.
check_lines.producer-signatures: Whether the producer's signature is valid on every record.
check_lines.witness-receipts: Whether each witness receipt in this file is valid.
check_lines.countersignature-types: Whether a countersignature of a type this page cannot check is valid.
check_lines.countersignature-receipts: Whether the receipt carried with a countersignature is valid.

checkpoint_not_checked_note: This page could not check it, and shows the file as unchanged without it.
full_verifier_line: To run these checks, check this file with a full verifier.
scope_line: None of these checks says who produced the records, or that this file is the most recent copy.

coverage_line.not_established: Which records the log's checkpoint covers could not be established.
